title: PAPA Standard Tattoo Cartridges
descriptionHtml:
PAPA Standard Tattoo Cartridge Needles provide consistent, high-precision everyday performance for professional tattoo studios. Engineered with medical-grade 316L stainless steel and internal elastic safety membranes.

  • Japanese 316L Surgical Stainless Steel needle pins ground with ultra-smooth tapers.
  • Medical Elastic Membrane system prevents pigment backflow into the machine grip.
  • Optical-Clear Polycarbonate Tip provides uninterrupted ink reservoir monitoring and smooth fluid delivery.
  • 100% EO Gas Sterilized in sterile individual blister packaging.
  • Universal Cartridge Docking fits Cheyenne, Bishop, FK Irons, Critical, and all rotary pens.
